annotation.title_clean: 国务院关于全国部分地区要素市场化配置综合改革试点实施方案的批复
annotation.title_en: State Council Reply on Implementation Plans for Comprehensive Pilot Reform of Market-Based Allocation of Factors in Selected Regions
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院 (State Council of the People's Republic of China)
annotation.summary_en: State Council reply approving two-year pilots of comprehensive market-based factor allocation reform in ten regions, with annexed city-level plans covering technology, land, labour, data, capital and resources. AI, autonomous driving, connected vehicles and unmanned systems appear only as priority application areas, not as governed subjects.
key_provisions_or_claims: Approves ten regional pilots for two years starting immediately
NDRC coordinates and manages risk; changes to laws require NPC or State Council authorisation
Plans promote data circulation rules, data security commitment systems and regulatory sandboxes
AI named as priority new-sector for factor allocation support
Hefei and Greater Bay Area plans promote air-land-sea unmanned intelligent systems application and standards
